Select T.TaskID,T.TaskStatusCode, T.AssignedOnDate AssignedOn, T.StartedOnDate StartedOn, T.CompletedOnDate CompletedOn, LTPT.Lookupcode ProcessTypeCode, LTPT.DisplayValue ProcessName, LTS.DisplayValue Status, LTT.Description TaskType, LTT.LookupCode TaskTypeCode, R.RoleAbbr SubRoleAbbr, R.RoleID SubRoleId, ISNULL(R1.RoleAbbr,R.RoleAbbr) RoleAbbr, ISNULL(R1.RoleID,R.RoleId) RoleID, trv.FieldValue TrackingNo, U.UserID, P.FirstName, P.LastName, I1.OrgCode as OrgCodeLevel1, I2.OrgCode as OrgCodeLevel2, I3.OrgCode as OrgCodeLevel3, I4.OrgCode as OrgCodeLevel4, pr.ActivityCode, pr.ProgramLongName, gr.GrantNumber, gr.GranteeName, gr.GranteeCity, gr.GranteeState, gr.SerialNumber, fc.AnnouncementNumber, fc.PBPSD, fc.FundingCycleLongName,gr.GrantId,gr.AwardNumber, convert(xml, (select tr2.fieldcode, fieldvalue,LF.DisplayValue FieldName from Activetask t2 join RelTaskProcessActiveTask rtpt2 on t2.TaskId = rtpt2.TaskId join TaskProcess tp2 on tp2.TaskProcessId = rtpt2.TaskProcessId join Activetaskrelatedvalue tr2 on (tr2.sourceProviderid = rtpt2.TaskId or tr2.sourceProviderid = rtpt2.TaskProcessId) JOIN dbo.RelTaskTypeFields rttf ON rttf.FieldCode = tr2.FieldCode AND rttf.TaskTypeCode = t2.TaskTypeCode join LookupField LF on LF.LookupCode = tr2.FieldCode where t2.taskid = T.TaskID ORDER BY rttf.DisplayOrder for xml auto)) as Fields FROM Activetask t join LookupTaskType LTT on LTT.LookupCode = T.TaskTypeCode join AC_Role R on LTT.RoleId = R.RoleId join LookupTaskStatus LTS on LTS.LookupCode = T.TaskStatusCode join RelTaskProcessActiveTask rtpt on t.TaskId = rtpt.TaskId join TaskProcess tp on tp.TaskProcessId = rtpt.TaskProcessId join TaskProcessOtherRelatedObjects tporo on tporo.TaskProcessId = tp.TaskProcessId join LookupTaskProcessType LTPT on LTPT.LookupCode = TP.TaskProcessTypeCode join AC_User U on U.UserId = T.AssigneeId join People P on P.UserId = U.UserId left outer join ActiveTaskRelatedValue trv on (trv.sourceProviderid = rtpt.TaskId or trv.sourceProviderid = rtpt.TaskProcessId) and trv.FieldCode = T.PrimaryFieldCode left outer join AC_Role R1 on R1.RoleID = R.ParentRoleID Left Join ( SELECT ProgramId, ActivityCode, ProgramLongName, ProgramShortName, Purpose FROM dbo.Programs pr WHERE (ProgramInstance = ( SELECT MAX(ProgramInstance) FROM Programs P WHERE P.ProgramId = IsNull(Pr.ParentProgramId, Pr.ProgramId) AND PR.ProgramId = P.ProgramId)) ) pr on pr.ProgramId = tporo.ProgramId Left Join( SELECT aw.GrantId, aw.AwardNumber,SUBSTRING(aw.GrantNumber, 3, 10) AS GrantNumber, GranteeName, ad.City GranteeCity, st.ShortDisplayValue GranteeState, gr.SerialNumber FROM dbo.Grants gr INNER JOIN dbo.Awards aw ON gr.GrantId = aw.GrantId and gr.lastawdnocurrbp = aw.awardnumber Join AwardAddresses ad on ad.GrantId = aw.GrantId and ad.AwardNumber = aw.AwardNumber and AddressPurposeCode = 4 and ad.addresstypecode = 1 left outer join lookupstate st on ad.statecode = st.lookupcode ) gr on IsNull(gr.GrantId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') = IsNull(tporo.GrantId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') Left Join ( SELECT fc.FundingCycleId, fc.AnnouncementNumber, fc.FundingCycleCode, fc.FundingCycleLongName, fc.ProjectedAwardDateRpt as PBPSD FROM dbo.fundingcycles fc )fc on IsNull(fc.FundingCycleId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') = IsNull(tporo.FundingCycleId, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') left outer join RelPeopleInternalOrganizations RP on P.PersonId = RP.PersonId left outer join InternalOrganizations I on I.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgId left outer join InternalOrganizations I1 on I1.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgLevel1 left outer join InternalOrganizations I2 on I2.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgLevel2 left outer join InternalOrganizations I3 on I3.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgLevel3 left outer join InternalOrganizations I4 on I4.InternalOrgId = RP.InternalOrgLevel4
2 (1,2)
Order by LTT.RoleId

statement.name: ApplicationsSearch
statement.sql: select awd.AwardReleaseDate as AwardReleaseDate, convert(VARCHAR(36),FMD.FundingMemoId) as FundingMemoId, convert(VARCHAR(36),FMD.FundingMemoLineId) as FundingMemoLineId, FM.FundingMemoTypeCode as FundingMemoTypeCode, prog.ProgramLongName as ProgramLongName, CASE WHEN fm.Statuscode=2 and isnull(fmd.CopiedtoAwardFlag,0)=0 and awd.awardreleasedate is null THEN FMD.BudgetPeriodStartDate else awd.BudgetPeriodStartDate end as BudgetPeriodStartDate, CASE WHEN fm.Statuscode=2 and isnull(fmd.CopiedtoAwardFlag,0)=0 and awd.awardreleasedate is null THEN FMD.BudgetPeriodEndDate else awd.BudgetPeriodEndDate end as BudgetPeriodEndDate, awd.AwardActionTypeCode, SUBSTRING(awd.grantnumber,3,10) GrantNumber, CASE WHEN fmd.CopiedtoAwardFlag=1 AND fm.Statuscode=2 AND awd.BudgetPeriodStartDate IS NOT NULL AND awd.BudgetPeriodendDate IS NOT null THEN ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),awd.BudgetPeriodStartDate,101),'') +'-'+ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),awd.BudgetPeriodEndDate,101) ,'') WHEN fm.Statuscode=2 and isnull(fmd.CopiedtoAwardFlag,0)=0 and awd.awardreleasedate is null THEN ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),FMD.BudgetPeriodStartDate,101),'') +'-'+ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),FMd.BudgetPeriodEndDate,101) ,'') WHEN gam.GrantActionMemoId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),awd.BudgetPeriodStartDate,101),'') +'-'+ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),awd.BudgetPeriodEndDate,101) ,'') END AS BudgetPeriod, Prog.ActivityCode as ActivityCode, fun.AnnouncementCode as AnnouncementCode , fun.AnnouncementNumber as AnnouncementNumber, case(isnull(app.OnlineSubmissionFlag,1)) when 0 then 'No' else 'Yes' end as OnlineSubmission, case(isnull(app.ApplicationStatusFlag,0)) when 0 then 'In Progress' when 1 then 'Submitted To AO' when 2 then 'Submitted To HRSA' when 5 then 'Edit By HRSA' when 6 then 'Submitted With Exception' else 'No Status Available' end as Applicationstatus, CASE when awd.AwardReleaseDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Awarded' WHEN Fm.statuscode=2 THEN 'Approved' END ReviewStatus, awd.AwardNumber, convert(VARCHAR(15),app.ApplicationTrackingNo) as ApplicationTrackingNumber, app.CreatedDate as CreatedDate, app.ApplicationTypeCode as ApplicationTypeCode, app.ApplicationSubmissionDate as SubmittedOn, IsNull('' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),app.ApplicationSubmissionDate,101) +'',' ') as SubmittedOnString, lat.ShortDisplayvalue ApplicationType, fun.ApplicationDeadline as ApplicationDeadline, app.ApplicationSubmissionDate, App.ApplicationId as ApplicationId, IsNull(fun.FundingCycleLongName, '') as FundingCycleLongName, IsNull(fun.FundingCycleShortName, '') as FundingCycleShortName, fun.FiscalYear, fun.fundingcyclecode, fun.FundingCycleId as FundingCycleId, fun.Description, isNull(LSST.ShortDisplayValue,'') as ApplicationSource, app.FundingCycleDisciplineCode as FundingCycleDisciplineCode, isNull(app.FundingCycleDisciplineTypeDisplayValue,'') as Discipline, isNull(AE.ApplicationEligibilityTypeCode,1) as ApplicationEligibility, IsNull(app.Othertrackingno, 'N/A') as GrantsTrackingNumber, app.SourceSystemTypeCode, ACE.ApplicationCompletenessEligibilityReviewId, convert(VARCHAR(36),APR.ApplicationPreFundingReviewId) as ApplicationPreFundingReviewId into #TempApplications from programs prog JOIN fundingcycles fun ON fun.ProgramInstance = prog.ProgramInstance and fun.ProgramId = prog.ProgramId JOIN hist_applications app ON fun.FundingCycleId = app.FundingCycleId join applications ap on ap.applicationid=app.applicationid and ap. VersionId=app.VersionId Join lookupapplicationtype lat on lat.lookupcode=app.applicationtypecode LEFT JOIN dbo.GrantActionMemo GAM ON GAM.ApplicationId=app.ApplicationId LEFT JOIN dbo.FundingMemoDetail FMD ON FMd.applicationid=app.applicationid LEFT JOIN dbo.fundingmemo FM ON FM.fundingmemoid=fmd.fundingmemoid LEFT JOIN awards awd ON (awd.sourceobjectid=gam.GrantActionMemoId) left join (select Awd1.grantnumber,Awd1.Grantid from grants gt LEFT JOIN dbo.Awards Awd1 ON Awd1.grantid=gt.Grantid AND gt.LastRelAwdNoLatestBP=awd1.awardnumber ) Awd1 on Awd1.Grantid=Awd.Grantid Left join LookupSourceSystemType LSST on app.SourceSystemTypeCode = LSST.LookupCode Left join ApplicationEligibility AE on AE.ApplicationId = App.ApplicationId LEFT JOIN dbo.ApplicationCompletenessEligibilityReview ACE ON ACE.applicationid=app.applicationid LEFT JOIN dbo.ApplicationPreFundingReview APR ON APr.applicationid=app.applicationid (1,2,3,7) ((GAM.ApplicationId IS NOT NULL AND Awd.awardreleasedate IS NOT null)) UNION ALL SELECT awd.AwardReleaseDate as AwardReleaseDate, convert(VARCHAR(36),FMD.FundingMemoId) as FundingMemoId, convert(VARCHAR(36),FMD.FundingMemoLineId) as FundingMemoLineId, FM.FundingMemoTypeCode as FundingMemoTypeCode, prog.ProgramLongName as ProgramLongName, CASE WHEN fm.Statuscode=2 and isnull(fmd.CopiedtoAwardFlag,0)=0 and awd.awardreleasedate is null THEN FMD.BudgetPeriodStartDate else awd.BudgetPeriodStartDate end as BudgetPeriodStartDate, CASE WHEN fm.Statuscode=2 and isnull(fmd.CopiedtoAwardFlag,0)=0 and awd.awardreleasedate is null THEN FMD.BudgetPeriodEndDate else awd.BudgetPeriodEndDate end as BudgetPeriodEndDate, awd.AwardActionTypeCode, SUBSTRING(awd.grantnumber,3,10) GrantNumber, CASE WHEN fmd.CopiedtoAwardFlag=1 AND fm.Statuscode=2 AND awd.BudgetPeriodStartDate IS NOT NULL AND awd.BudgetPeriodendDate IS NOT null THEN ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),awd.BudgetPeriodStartDate,101),'') +'-'+ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),awd.BudgetPeriodEndDate,101) ,'') WHEN fm.Statuscode=2 and isnull(fmd.CopiedtoAwardFlag,0)=0 and awd.awardreleasedate is null THEN ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),FMD.BudgetPeriodStartDate,101),'') +'-'+ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),FMd.BudgetPeriodEndDate,101) ,'') WHEN gam.GrantActionMemoId IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),awd.BudgetPeriodStartDate,101),'') +'-'+ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),awd.BudgetPeriodEndDate,101) ,'') END AS BudgetPeriod, Prog.ActivityCode as ActivityCode, fun.AnnouncementCode as AnnouncementCode , fun.AnnouncementNumber as AnnouncementNumber, case(isnull(app.OnlineSubmissionFlag,1)) when 0 then 'No' else 'Yes' end as OnlineSubmission, case(isnull(app.ApplicationStatusFlag,0)) when 0 then 'In Progress' when 1 then 'Submitted To AO' when 2 then 'Submitted To HRSA' when 5 then 'Edit By HRSA' when 6 then 'Submitted With Exception' else 'No Status Available' end as Applicationstatus, CASE when awd.AwardReleaseDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Awarded' WHEN Fm.statuscode=2 THEN 'Approved' END ReviewStatus, awd.AwardNumber, convert(VARCHAR(15),app.ApplicationTrackingNo) as ApplicationTrackingNumber, app.CreatedDate as CreatedDate, app.ApplicationTypeCode as ApplicationTypeCode, app.ApplicationSubmissionDate as SubmittedOn, IsNull('' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),app.ApplicationSubmissionDate,101) +'',' ') as SubmittedOnString, lat.ShortDisplayvalue ApplicationType, fun.ApplicationDeadline as ApplicationDeadline, app.ApplicationSubmissionDate, App.ApplicationId as ApplicationId, IsNull(fun.FundingCycleLongName, '') as FundingCycleLongName, IsNull(fun.FundingCycleShortName, '') as FundingCycleShortName, fun.FiscalYear, fun.fundingcyclecode, fun.FundingCycleId as FundingCycleId, fun.Description, isNull(LSST.ShortDisplayValue,'') as ApplicationSource, app.FundingCycleDisciplineCode as FundingCycleDisciplineCode, isNull(app.FundingCycleDisciplineTypeDisplayValue,'') as Discipline, isNull(AE.ApplicationEligibilityTypeCode,1) as ApplicationEligibility, IsNull(app.Othertrackingno, 'N/A') as GrantsTrackingNumber, app.SourceSystemTypeCode, ACE.ApplicationCompletenessEligibilityReviewId, convert(VARCHAR(36),APR.ApplicationPreFundingReviewId) as ApplicationPreFundingReviewId from programs prog JOIN fundingcycles fun ON fun.ProgramInstance = prog.ProgramInstance and fun.ProgramId = prog.ProgramId JOIN hist_applications app ON fun.FundingCycleId = app.FundingCycleId join applications ap on ap.applicationid=app.applicationid and ap. VersionId=app.VersionId Join lookupapplicationtype lat on lat.lookupcode=app.applicationtypecode LEFT JOIN dbo.GrantActionMemo GAM ON GAM.ApplicationId=app.ApplicationId LEFT JOIN dbo.FundingMemoDetail FMD ON FMd.applicationid=app.applicationid LEFT JOIN dbo.fundingmemo FM ON FM.fundingmemoid=fmd.fundingmemoid LEFT JOIN awards awd ON (awd.sourceobjectid=app.applicationid) left join (select Awd1.grantnumber,Awd1.Grantid from grants gt LEFT JOIN dbo.Awards Awd1 ON Awd1.grantid=gt.Grantid AND gt.LastRelAwdNoLatestBP=awd1.awardnumber ) Awd1 on Awd1.Grantid=Awd.Grantid Left join LookupSourceSystemType LSST on app.SourceSystemTypeCode = LSST.LookupCode Left join ApplicationEligibility AE on AE.ApplicationId = App.ApplicationId LEFT JOIN dbo.ApplicationCompletenessEligibilityReview ACE ON ACE.applicationid=app.applicationid LEFT JOIN dbo.ApplicationPreFundingReview APR ON APr.applicationid=app.applicationid (1,2,3,7) 2 AwardReleaseDate, FundingMemoId, FundingMemoLineId, FundingMemoTypeCode, ProgramLongName, BudgetPeriodStartDate, BudgetPeriodEndDate, AwardActionTypeCode, GrantNumber, BudgetPeriod, ActivityCode, AnnouncementCode , AnnouncementNumber, OnlineSubmission, Applicationstatus, ReviewStatus, AwardNumber, ApplicationTrackingNumber, CreatedDate, ApplicationTypeCode, SubmittedOn, SubmittedOnString, ApplicationType, ApplicationDeadline, ApplicationSubmissionDate, ApplicationId, FundingCycleLongName, FundingCycleShortName, FiscalYear, fundingcyclecode, FundingCycleId, Description, ApplicationSource, FundingCycleDisciplineCode, Discipline, ApplicationEligibility, GrantsTrackingNumber, SourceSystemTypeCode, ApplicationCompletenessEligibilityReviewId, ApplicationPreFundingReviewId from #TempApplications

statement.name: GetNewAssigneeUsers
statement.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Lu.userId as UserId, getDate() as TodaysDate from UserRoleWorkAssignments URWA JOIN LU_Users Lu on URWA.UserId = Lu.userId where datediff(dd, URWA.LastUpdateDate, GetDate()) = 0 and NotifyUserFlag = 1

statement.name: GetDefaultAssignmentDetails
statement.sql:
SELECT URWA.UserID as AssigneeID, URWA.UserRoleWorkAssignmentId AssignmentID, PR.ActivityCode AssignmentName, 'Program' as AssignmentType, R.RoleAbbr FROM UserRoleWorkAssignments URWA join Programs PR on convert(varchar(40), PR.ProgramId) = URWA.ResourceValue and URWA.ResourceTypeCode = 13 join AC_Role R on R.RoleId = URWA.RoleId where datediff(dd, URWA.LastUpdateDate, GetDate()) = 0 and NotifyUserFlag = 1
UNION
SELECT URWA.UserID as AssigneeID, URWA.UserRoleWorkAssignmentId AssignmentID, PR.ActivityCode + ':' + LS.ShortDisplayValue AssignmentName, 'State' as AssignmentType, R.RoleAbbr FROM UserRoleWorkAssignments URWA join AC_Role R on R.RoleId = URWA.RoleId join LookupState LS on convert(varchar(40), LS.LookupCode) = URWA.ResourceValue and URWA.ResourceTypeCode = 18 join UserRoleWorkAssignmentsContext URWAC on URWA.UserRoleWorkAssignmentId = URWAC.UserRoleWorkAssignmentId join Programs PR on PR.ProgramId = URWAC.ResourceValueCtx and URWAC.ResourceTypeCodeCtx = 13 where datediff(dd, URWA.LastUpdateDate, GetDate()) = 0 and NotifyUserFlag = 1
UNION
SELECT URWA.UserID as AssigneeID, URWA.UserRoleWorkAssignmentId AssignmentID, AW.GrantNumber AssignmentName, 'Grant' as AssignmentType, R.RoleAbbr FROM UserRoleWorkAssignments URWA join Grants GR on convert(varchar(40), GR.GrantId) = URWA.ResourceValue and URWA.ResourceTypeCode = 12 join Awards aw on aw.GrantID = GR.GrantID and GR.LastAwdNoCurrBP = aw.awardnumber join AC_Role R on R.RoleId = URWA.RoleId where datediff(dd, URWA.LastUpdateDate, GetDate()) = 0 and NotifyUserFlag = 1

statement.name: GetNewAssignee
